Description: Moves the drivetrain forward or in reverse using the current drive velocity. This block runs continuously until another Drivetrain block interrupts it or the project stops.
Parameters: direction: The direction the robot drives (forward, reverse)

Description: Moves the drivetrain forward or in reverse for a specified distance using the current drive velocity.
Parameters: direction: The direction the robot drives (forward, reverse); distance: The distance the robot drives as an integer or decimal; unit: The unit of measurement (mm, inches); expanding arrow: Toggle waiting/non-waiting behavior (and don't wait)

Description: Turns the drivetrain continuously left or right using the current turn velocity. The drivetrain will keep turning until another drivetrain block runs or the project stops.
Parameters: direction: The direction the robot turns (left, right)

Description: Turns the drivetrain left or right for a specific number of degrees using the current turn velocity.
Parameters: direction: The direction the robot turns (left, right); angle: The number of degrees the robot turns as an integer or decimal; expanding arrow: Toggle waiting/non-waiting behavior (and don't wait)

Description: Turns the drivetrain to face a specific heading using the current turn velocity.
Parameters: heading: The absolute heading the drivetrain will turn to from -360 to 360 degrees; expanding arrow: Toggle waiting/non-waiting behavior (and don't wait)

Description: Turns the drivetrain to face a specific rotational value using the current turn velocity.
Parameters: rotation: The cumulative rotation value the robot will turn to as an integer or decimal; expanding arrow: Toggle waiting/non-waiting behavior (and don't wait)

Description: Immediately stops all movement of the drivetrain.
Sets the default movement speed as a percentage for all subsequent movement blocks. Default is 50%.
Parameters: velocity: Sets the default movement velocity from 0% to 100%

Description: Sets the default velocity as a percentage for all subsequent turn blocks. Default is 50%.
Parameters: velocity: Sets the default turn velocity from 0% to 100%

Description: Sets the gyro's current heading to a specified value.
Parameters: heading: The heading value to assign in degrees

Description: Sets the gyro's current cumulative rotation value.
Parameters: rotation: The cumulative rotation value to assign in degrees

Description: Sets a time limit for how long a Drivetrain block will wait to reach its target. If the robot cannot complete the movement within the set time it will stop automatically.
Parameters: time: The maximum number of seconds a Drivetrain block will run before stopping

Description: Returns a Boolean indicating whether the drivetrain is not moving. True if not moving; False if moving.
Returns a Boolean indicating whether the drivetrain is moving. True if moving; False if not moving.
Returns the drivetrain's heading angle as a decimal number in the range 0 to 359.99 degrees.
Returns how much the drivetrain has turned since the project started in degrees: positive for clockwise negative for counterclockwise.
Sets the state of the electromagnet to pick up or drop objects.
Parameters: state: State to charge the magnet to (boost - pick up objects, drop - stop picking up/drop)

Description: Returns a Boolean based on the Bumper Sensor state. True if pressed; False if not pressed.
Parameters: bumper sensor: Bumper Sensor to check

Description: Executes the attached stack of blocks when the Bumper Sensor is pressed or released.
Parameters: bumper sensor: Bumper Sensor to monitor; actions: Trigger on pressed or released

Description: Returns a Boolean indicating whether the Distance Sensor has detected an object within 2000 mm. True if detected; False if not detected.
Returns the distance of the nearest object from the Distance Sensor.
Parameters: unit: The unit of measurement (mm, inches)

Description: Returns a Boolean indicating whether the Eye Sensor detects an object.
Parameters: eye: The Eye Sensor to use

Description: Returns a Boolean indicating whether the Eye Sensor detects a specified color.
Parameters: eye: The Eye Sensor to use; color: Color to detect (red, green, blue)

Description: Returns the brightness detected by the Eye Sensor (0%-100%).
Parameters: eye: The Eye Sensor to use

Description: Triggers actions when the Eye Sensor detects or loses an object.
Parameters: eye: The Eye Sensor to use; state: Action to trigger (detects or loses an object)

Description: Returns the X or Y coordinate position of the VR Robot.
Parameters: axis: The axis to return the position of (X, Y); units: The unit to represent the position (mm, inches)

Description: Returns the angle of the robot in degrees.
Controls pen position to enable/disable drawing.
Parameters: position: Pen position (down, up)

Description: Controls line thickness with 5 presets available.
Parameters: width: Line width preset (extra thin, thin, medium, wide, extra wide)

Description: Selects from 4 preset colors for the pen.
Parameters: color: Preset color (black, red, green, blue)

Description: Sets a custom RGB color with opacity control for the pen.
Parameters: red: 0-255; green: 0-255; blue: 0-255; opacity: 0-100%

Description: Fills enclosed spaces with custom RGB color.
Parameters: red: 0-255; green: 0-255; blue: 0-255; opacity: 0-100%

Description: Outputs values/variables to the console. Expanded version moves cursor to next line after printing.
Parameters: value: Text number or variable to display

Description: Moves cursor position to column 1 of next line.
Resets console by removing all printed content.
Sets decimal precision for numbers displayed in the console.
Parameters: value: Precision level (1, 0.1, 0.01, 0.001, All Digits)

Description: Changes text color in the console.
Parameters: color: Available colors (black, red, green, blue)

Description: Pauses execution for a specific amount of time before moving to the next block.
Parameters: time: The amount of time to wait as a positive integer or decimal in seconds

Description: Pauses execution until a specified condition is met before proceeding to the next block.
Parameters: condition: The condition that must be met before moving on to the next block

Description: Runs the blocks inside it a set number of times.
Parameters: times: A whole number that sets how many times the repeat block runs

Description: Keeps running the blocks inside it again and again without stopping.
Executes the enclosed blocks repeatedly while the condition evaluates as False. Stops when condition is True.
Parameters: condition: An expression or variable evaluated before each iteration (False continues; True stops)

Description: Executes the enclosed blocks repeatedly while the condition evaluates as True. Stops when condition is False.
Parameters: condition: An expression or variable evaluated before each iteration (True continues; False stops)

Description: Executes the enclosed block of code if the condition evaluates as True.
Parameters: condition: An expression or variable evaluated when the statement runs (True executes; False skips)

Description: Determines which enclosed block of code runs based on whether the condition evaluates as True or False.
Parameters: condition: An expression or variable evaluated when the statement runs (True runs if block; False runs else block)

Description: Selects which enclosed block of code runs based on multiple conditions. First true condition determines which block executes; else runs if none are true.
Parameters: condition: An expression or variable evaluated when the statement runs

Description: Exits a repeat forever repeat until or while loop immediately.
Ends the execution of the project.
Resets the timer to zero.
Returns the elapsed time since the timer was last reset as a decimal in seconds.
Activates the attached stack of blocks after a specified amount of time.
Parameters: time: Specifies the number of seconds before the attached stack of blocks starts (whole or decimal numbers)

Description: Runs its stack when the project begins. Multiple when started blocks can run multiple stacks at once.
Starts a stack when a matching event is broadcast. Multiple blocks can run multiple stacks at once.
Parameters: event: The event to be triggered (select existing create new rename or delete)

Description: Triggers any matching when I receive event hat block. Does not pause execution and continues running the next block immediately.
Parameters: event: The event to trigger (select existing create new rename or delete)

Description: Triggers an event then pauses execution of the current stack until all triggered when I receive event block stacks have completed.
Parameters: event: The event to trigger (select existing create new rename or delete)

Description: Performs basic arithmetic on the values placed on either side. Returns a result based on the project's print precision.
Parameters: value 1: The first number; operator: Mathematical operator (+, -, *, /); value 2: The second number

Description: Returns a Boolean indicating whether the comparison between two values is true or false.
Parameters: value 1: The first value to compare; operator: Comparison operator (=, <, ≤, >, ≥); value 2: The second value to compare

Description: Returns a Boolean indicating whether the logical condition between multiple values is true or false.
Parameters: condition 1: The first Boolean condition; operator: Logical operator (and, or); condition 2: The second Boolean condition

Description: Inverts the result of a Boolean block. True becomes False and False becomes True.
Parameters: condition: The Boolean condition to be inverted

Description: Returns a Boolean indicating whether a value falls within a specified range.
Parameters: first operator: Comparison operator (<, ≤, >, ≥); value: The value to check; second operator: Comparison operator (<, ≤, >, ≥)

Description: Returns a random integer within the specified range.
Parameters: min: The lowest possible number; max: The highest possible number

Description: Returns the given number rounded to the nearest whole number following standard rounding rules.
Parameters: number: The number to round; decimal places: The amount of decimal places to round to

Description: Applies a selected mathematical function to a given number and returns the result.
Parameters: function: Mathematical operation (abs, floor, ceiling, sqrt, sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan, ln, log, e^, 10^, negative); number: The number to apply the function to

Description: Returns the inverse tangent of Y/X as an angle in degrees representing the angle between the positive X-axis and the point (X Y).
Parameters: x: The horizontal position of the point; y: The vertical position of the point

Description: Returns the remainder of the division operation between two values.
Parameters: dividend: The number to be divided; divisor: The number to divide by

Description: Returns a single string that combines two or more input strings.
Parameters: string 1: The first string to combine; string 2: The second string to combine

Description: Returns a single-character string from the specified position in the given string.
Parameters: position: The position of the character in the string (starting at 1); string: The string to extract a letter from

Description: Returns the number of characters in the specified string including spaces.
Parameters: string: The string to measure the length of

Description: Returns a Boolean indicating whether the specified string includes the given word or character.
Parameters: string: The main string to search within; search term: The word or character to check for

Description: Returns the value of a number converted to the specified type either as text or a number.
Parameters: value: The number to convert; type: The type to convert into (text, number)

Description: Returns the value of a numeric variable.
Assigns a value to a numeric variable.
Parameters: variable: The numeric variable to assign a value to; value: The number assigned to the variable

Description: Increases or decreases a variable's value by a given amount.
Parameters: variable: The numeric variable to modify; value: The amount to increase or decrease by

Description: Returns the value of a Boolean variable (True or False).
Assigns a True or False value to a Boolean variable.
Parameters: variable: The Boolean variable to assign a value to; value: A Boolean value (True or False)

Description: Returns the value of an item in a list.
Parameters: index: The position of the item in the list (starting at 1); variable: The list variable to return an item from

Description: Updates a specific item in a list.
Parameters: variable: The list variable containing the item to modify; index: The position of the item (starting at 1); value: The new value assigned

Description: Sets every item in the list to the entered values.
Parameters: variable: The list variable being assigned values; values: The values to store in the list

Description: Returns the number of items in a list.
Parameters: variable: The list variable to return the length of

Description: Returns the value of an item from a specific row and column in a 2D list.
Parameters: row: The row of the item (starting at 1); column: The column of the item (starting at 1); variable: The 2D list variable

Description: Updates a specific item in a 2D list.
Parameters: row: The row index (starting at 1); column: The column index (starting at 1); variable: The 2D list variable; value: The new value assigned

Description: Sets every item in the 2D list to the entered values.
Parameters: variable: The 2D list variable being assigned values; values: The values to store row by row

Description: Returns the number of rows or columns in a 2D list.
Parameters: variable: The 2D list variable; rows/columns: Whether to return the number of rows or columns

Description: Groups code into reusable sections designed to perform a specific task. Can be called multiple times within a program. Equivalent to functions in Python.
Parameters: block name: A name you give to your My Block; parameters: Optional variables that accept input values (number or Boolean)

Description: Adds explanations or notes within the project. Does not affect how the project runs.
Used to execute Switch Python commands typed within the open space of the block. Shaped to attach above or below other action blocks.
Parameters: None (Python code is typed directly in the block)

Description: Used to loop the blocks within until the condition in the open space of the block is met. Common uses: while if for.
Parameters: None (Python condition is typed directly in the block)

Description: Used to loop the blocks within a specific branch when the condition is met. Additional branches can be added by expanding the block. Common uses: while if for.
Parameters: None (Python condition is typed directly in the block)

Description: Returns a condition as either True or False defined with Switch Python functions. Shaped to fit inside hexagonal inputs. Operators: and or not > < = <= != >=.
Parameters: None (Python expression is typed directly in the block)

Description: Returns a numeric value defined with Switch Python functions. Shaped to fit inside circular inputs. Operators: + - / *.
Parameters: None (Python expression is typed directly in the block)

Description: Runs the attached stack of blocks when the function is called. Syntax: def function_name(parameter):
Parameters: None (Python function definition is typed directly in the block)
